FieldDefinition.description:
One custom field on a portal form.

``name`` is the stable key used in ``Ticket.field_values``. If
``ado_field_ref`` is set (e.g. ``Microsoft.VSTS.Common.Priority``) the value
is mapped directly onto that ADO field; otherwise the value is appended to
the work-item description and mirrored into an Azuregos metadata tag.

get.description: Valid area paths for ``project`` (or the server default if omitted).

schema.title: Response List Area Paths Api Ado Area Paths Get

delete.description: Remove the saved connection, reverting to the ADO_* env vars.

get.description: Which connection is in effect, plus the saved and env values (no PATs).

put.description:
Save the UI connection; it then takes precedence over the ADO_* env vars.

The values are verified against ADO first. A definite rejection (bad PAT,
unknown org/project) blocks the save; a transient error doesn't, matching
how portal saves treat an unreachable ADO.

post.description: Check connection values without saving. A blank PAT uses the saved one.

get.description:

schema.title: Response List Projects Api Ado Projects Get

post.description:
Post a reply to a ticket's discussion.

Comments are created in ADO under the service account, so we prepend an
attribution line naming the real author.

Force an immediate re-sync of a pending/failed ticket (admin, or an
admin of the ticket's portal).

schema.title: Response List Users Api Users Get
